questions.prompt: Describe the first five minutes of a new customer's experience.
questions.defaultHint: Sign up, verify email, create a workspace, land on an empty state with one clear next action.

questions.prompt: What is the one action the product exists to make easy?
questions.defaultHint: Derived from the product's one-sentence summary.

questions.prompt: What action would cause a support ticket if it went wrong?
questions.defaultHint: Losing or corrupting the user's primary data.

questions.prompt: For your top three journeys, what happens on the unhappy path (validation failure, conflict, timeout)?
questions.defaultHint: A clear inline error, no data loss, and retrying is always safe.

questions.prompt: Which of these journeys must keep working if a dependency (email, storage, search) is down?
questions.defaultHint: Core create/read/update/delete must keep working; notifications may be delayed.
